# netbox_custom_fields (Data Source)

Lists NetBox custom field objects (`/api/extras/custom-fields/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_custom_fields" "all" {}

data "netbox_custom_fields" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "q", value = "example" },
  ]
  limit = 10
}

output "custom_fields_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_custom_fields.filtered.items[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/extras/custom-fields/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `choice_set_id` (Number) ID of the Custom Field Choice Set (`netbox_custom_field_choice_set`).
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `data_type` (String) Data Type.
- `default` (String) Default value for the field (must be a JSON value). Encapsulate strings with double quotes (e.g. "Foo").
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `filter_logic` (String) Loose matches any instance of a given string; exact matches the entire field. Valid values: `disabled`, `loose`, `exact`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `group_name` (String) Custom fields within the same group will be displayed together. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `is_cloneable` (Boolean) Replicate this value when cloning objects. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `label` (String) Name of the field as displayed to users (if not provided, 'the field's name will be used). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `name` (String) Internal field name.
- `nulls_first` (Boolean) Sort null values before non-null values when ordering by this field. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object Types.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `related_object_filter` (String) Filter the object selection choices using a query_params dict (must be a JSON value).Encapsulate strings with double quotes (e.g. "Foo").
- `related_object_type` (String) Related Object Type.
- `required` (Boolean) This field is required when creating new objects or editing an existing object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `search_weight` (Number) Weighting for search. Lower values are considered more important. Fields with a search weight of zero will be ignored. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `type` (String) The type of data this custom field holds. Valid values: `text`, `longtext`, `integer`, `decimal`, `boolean`, `date`, `datetime`, `url`, `json`, `select`, `multiselect`, `object`, `multiobject`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `ui_editable` (String) Specifies whether the custom field value can be edited in the UI. Valid values: `yes`, `no`, `hidden`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `ui_visible` (String) Specifies whether the custom field is displayed in the UI. Valid values: `always`, `if-set`, `hidden`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `unique` (Boolean) The value of this field must be unique for the assigned object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `url` (String) Url.
- `validation_maximum` (Number) Maximum allowed value (for numeric fields).
- `validation_minimum` (Number) Minimum allowed value (for numeric fields).
- `validation_regex` (String) Regular expression to enforce on text field values. Use ^ and $ to force matching of entire string. For example, <code>^[A-Z]{3}$</code> will limit values to exactly three uppercase letters. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `validation_schema` (String) A JSON schema definition for validating the custom field value.
- `weight` (Number) Fields with higher weights appear lower in a form. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
